name: refui-flutter-web
description: Flutter Web build scripts for RDK Reference UI

scripts.flutter-dist: cd flutter-app && flutter clean && flutter pub get && flutter build web --release && cd .. && (if exist flutter-dist rmdir /s /q flutter-dist) && xcopy /E /I flutter-app\build\web flutter-dist
scripts.flutter-dist:unix: cd flutter-app && flutter clean && flutter pub get && flutter build web --release && cd .. && rm -rf flutter-dist && cp -r flutter-app/build/web flutter-dist
